q011.cause: "Last 1 day" has no rolling period in the enum (today/yesterday/last_7_days…); Sonnet chose period today (3,472 events since midnight, and the tool's today also ran to the end of the day).
q011.fix: window {"last":"24h"|"Nd"} as the one time argument, rolling by default; every window clamped to now.

q015.cause: resolve_client period last_12_months counted 8,373 events stamped after now (the 400M load has rows up to 17:59 today): windows were not clamped to now.
q015.fix: Every window ends at the latest at now (clampToNow).

q021.cause: Own SQL over 7 calendar days including today (2026-11-19..26), counting rows after now; "last 7 days" is rolling.
q021.fix: Descriptions and instructions: window {"last":"7d"} is what "last 7 days" means; SQL must bound timestamp < now(); recipes give the count without SQL.

q040.cause: Own SQL: 30 calendar days including today and rows after now.

q048.cause: Own SQL anchored the 7 days at the latest event (17:59 today, in the future), not at now.

q052.cause: Own SQL: 30 calendar days to tomorrow (2026-10-27..11-26), counting rows after now.

q100.cause: resolve_client gave the right 7-day count (122,481) but Sonnet replaced it with its own calendar-week SQL (114,452) because the result did not say which window it covered.
q100.fix: Every result starts with context: the resolved window (from, to, kind).

q076.cause: design_survey job failed: its 30-day step checks (15 s budget each, run together) timed out at 400M rows, and those client-side timeouts counted toward Lens's PostHog circuit breaker, which then refused the reach estimate and every call for 30 s ("PostHog is unavailable or busy").
q076.fix: Breaker counts only normal-deadline timeouts (test added); step checks get 40 s and run in parallel with the reach estimate; the fallback warning names existing tools (it named the removed describe_app_events).

q079.cause: Same as q076: the job failed before reporting the 90-day reach cap.

q044.cause: Ground truth counted PageView rows of the messagebox dialog; Lens's data_guide (and Sonnet) define messages as Event rows. Corrected and regraded (passes).
q044.fix: Ground truth: event = 'Event' for all message questions.

q071.cause: The simulated data has no "Trade Date" field; Sonnet correctly answered none found. Question changed to a behaviour check and regraded (passes).
